root_idea.summary: The supplied evidence centers on attaining maturity or ripeness, especially in fruit.
root_idea.development: The evidence connects the verbal idea of becoming ripe with the nominal designation of ripeness or mature fruit.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested nominal form is presented under its normalized lexical headword.

senses.definition: Ripeness or mature development, specifically the state of fruit having reached maturity.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in the Quranic possessive construction وَيَنْعِهِ, “its ripeness.” A recorded variant reading has يُنْعِهِ; the term is also related to يَانِع, “ripe” or “mature.”

cautions: The packet supplies one Quranic occurrence and no Lane or Maqayis evidence; broader Classical Arabic meanings are therefore not asserted beyond the supplied Quran-focused lexical evidence.
